issues.where: the Skills Assessment placeholder, right edge and bottom
issues.what: the only placeholder on the page, a ring over a pill, is pushed against the right margin and slightly past the 1303 px content edge, and is cut off by the bottom of the viewport. The left two thirds below the intro text are empty, and nothing says what the object is or what to do. There is also no Continue or other action visible at rest, so the page has no clear order of importance
issues.fix: centre the assessment object in the content area, or give it a defined right column that starts below the intro and fits inside the viewport. Add a short label or instruction under the intro, plus the page's action, aligned to the same right edge as the Continue buttons on the other pages

issues.where: the film's control bar, bottom of the frame
issues.what: the dark control bar sits over the band where the page's ticker runs, so the ticker ('Company Retreat: One Survivor…') is fully hidden in the film. The large play button also floats between the hero and the cards, on no column
issues.fix: put the control bar below the film's frame, or hide it automatically while playing so the ticker shows. Keep the play button centred on the whole frame or on the hero block, not in the gap between the hero and the cards

issues.what: Submit is centred on the page at x≈698, while every other action in the application (the Continue buttons on steps 1 and 2) is right-aligned to the 1303 px content edge. It also sits about 280 px below the verification card with nothing in between, and the right half of the page is empty
issues.fix: right-align Submit to the content edge like Continue, and move it up so it sits about 60 to 80 px below the verification note, or put it in the same bottom-right position used on step 2

issues.what: Continue is a light outlined pill here, while on step 2 it is a dark filled pill. It is also pinned to the bottom of the viewport, about 230 px below the last field, where step 2 puts it right under the fields. The primary action changes weight and position from step to step
issues.fix: use one style and one placement for the primary action on every step. If the light style means disabled, make that clear and keep the same position

issues.where: the mute icon and 'Watch the film instead' link, top left
issues.what: the controls are clear of the content but squeezed into the header's top padding about 34 px above the logo. At 73% the link reads at about 9 px and is easy to miss as the way to switch to the film
issues.fix: give the controls their own slim bar above the header, with about 16 px of padding. Alternatively, move them to the top right, level with the nav, and set the link at 14 px or more

issues.where: the step indicator pill, top right
issues.what: the pill extends about 10 px past the 1303 px content edge that the header rule and the Continue button align to, so the header's right edge does not line up
issues.fix: inset the pill so its outer edge sits on the 1303 px content edge

issues.what: the title and line in each card sit in the upper middle, with about 60 px of empty card below, so the cards look taller than their content
issues.fix: either reduce the card height to about 130 px or vertically centre the text block in each card

issues.what: this set has no sheets for the film's beats, step 1's beats or the pinball cameras, so the order and pace of the beats and the framing of the cameras could not be judged from these files
issues.fix: none needed in this set; make sure those sheets reach another critic
